messages:
Alex (eng-infra): FYI AWS sent a counter-proposal for GPU commitments. Highlights: 2yr term, region guarantees for us-west-2 + eu-west-1, AZ portability only, 25% off list. Thoughts?

aws-quote-bot: Draft term sheet available: https://aws.example.com/edp/174/term-sheet. Quote ID: AWS-Q-9987

Nina (finance): Heads-up: our internal demand curve only shows strong growth for ~12 months. A 24mo lock at 25% could backfire vs. rolling 12mo + spot/credits. Need a blended TCO comparison.

Sam (eng-ml): We can't bind to a single SKU for two years. Workloads shift between A100, H100, and mid-tier cards. Need SKU-flex or equivalence language.

Marco (sales): Rep offered a "swap" allowance: up to 20% of units per year can change SKU with a price re-eval. Also proposed hard capacity hold: 150 A100-equivalent cards / region at peak.

Jen (legal): Flag termination penalties and make-whole. If they fail capacity guarantees we need explicit credits + guaranteed fallback access at a stated rate.

Alex (eng-infra): Also requesting emergency cross-region portability for outages. Must be able to reassign capacity (eu-west-1 -> eu-central-1) temporarily without penalty.

aws-quote-bot: Rep notes: emergency cross-region swap allowed up to 30 days, twice yearly, admin approval required; subject to availability and may include small markup.

Sam (eng-ml): A markup kills the economics. Request cap on markup (<=3%) and a failover SLA: provisioning and network bandwidth provisioned <6 hours.

Marco (sales): I'll push for capped markup + SLA. Also asking for an option to convert unused reserved units into commit credits/Savings Plan if internal pricing changes.

Nina (finance): Billing ask: last month had unexpected egress and snapshot charges. Request AWS provide a line-item breakdown and exclude one-off egress over our forecast from EDP true-up.

Jen (legal): Add quarterly audit rights and invoice samples. If AWS mis-attributes resources vs billed reservations, they must issue credits. I'll draft language.

Alex (eng-infra): Technical: if GPUs are migrated between hosts we need a documented migration/warmup window to preserve in-flight KV caches and avoid lost inference sessions. Include max tolerated downtime in SLA.

Sam (eng-ml): I'll post a short doc with SKU equivalency matrix and 6-hr failover test cases to #eng-ml.

Marco (sales): Action list: I'll negotiate pricing caps, capped swap markup, emergency swap SLA, and ask for 12mo partial opt-out at month 12. Want redline by Wed EOD.

Jen (legal): I'll prepare a redline and request past 6 months of usage and sample invoices for their reconciliation.

Nina (finance): Please include a blended cost model comparing 12mo vs 24mo at 25% off, with spot/burst scenarios. We need to know break-even.

Alex (eng-infra): If we secure capped markup, cross-region swaps, SKU flexibility, and audit credits, a 2yr commit with 12mo partial opt-out is reasonable. Otherwise prefer 12mo.

aws-quote-bot: Reminder: Quote AWS-Q-9987 expires in 14 days.

Nina (finance): Prioritizing this. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
